title: MetaDecomp: Adaptive Task Decomposition via Meta-Learned Procedural Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.33822v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reusing past experience in long-horizon tasks requires more than storing successful procedures: Language agents must distinguish which procedures apply and what work remains as execution progresses. We introduce MetaDecomp, an in-context meta-learning framework for adaptive task decomposition that jointly learns a task-relative state space and reusable procedures. Its outer loop builds procedural memory from successful training executions, representing task progress as abstract states and procedures between states as directed acyclic graphs of operations and dependencies. As new progress distinctions are learned, MetaDecomp revisits historical execution evidence to reassess state assignments and reorganize the procedures they support. With memory fixed at test time, the inner loop refines an initial decomposition and revises it from environmental feedback, combining applicable procedure fragments with task-specific steps missing from mem

translated_title: MetaDecomp：基于元学习程序记忆的自适应任务分解
translated_abstract: 在长程任务中重用过往经验不仅仅是存储成功的程序：语言智能体必须区分哪些程序适用，以及随着执行进展还有哪些工作待完成。我们提出了MetaDecomp，一个用于自适应任务分解的上下文元学习框架，它联合学习任务相关的状态空间和可重用程序。其外循环从成功的训练执行中构建程序记忆，将任务进度表示为抽象状态，并将状态之间的程序表示为操作与依赖关系构成的有向无环图。随着学习到新的进度区分，MetaDecomp会重新审视历史执行证据，以重新评估状态分配并重组其所支持的程序。在测试时记忆保持固定的情况下，内循环细化初始分解并根据环境反馈对其进行修订，将适用的程序片段与记忆中缺失的任务特定步骤相结合。
tldr: MetaDecomp提出了一种上下文元学习框架，其外循环从成功执行中构建以抽象状态和有向无环图组织的可重用程序记忆，内循环则在测试时结合记忆中的程序片段与环境反馈，自适应地细化并修订任务分解。
en_tdlr: MetaDecomp is an in-context meta-learning framework whose outer loop builds reusable procedural memory as abstract states organized in directed acyclic graphs, while its inner loop adaptively refines and revises task decompositions at test time by combining applicable memory fragments with environmental feedback.
